'''GIPCL Vadodara Gas based Power Station''' is [[Gas turbine]] based [[combined cycle power plant]]. It is located at Dhanora village in [[Vadodara]], [[Gujarat]]. The power plant is run by state-owned Gujarat Industrial Power Corporation Limited (GIPCL).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vadodara Station-I {{!}} Gas Based Power Plants {{!}} Power Generation {{!}} Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd.|url=http://www.gipcl.com/vadodara-station-i.htm|access-date=2021-02-28|website=www.gipcl.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Vadodara Station-II {{!}} Gas Based Power Plants {{!}} Power Generation {{!}} Gujarat Industries Power Company Ltd.|url=http://www.gipcl.com/vadodara-station-ii.htm|access-date=2021-02-28|website=www.gipcl.com}}</ref> The primary electricity generation is through the Gas turbines. [[Waste heat]] from the gas turbine is recovered by a [[heat recovery steam generator]] (HRSG) to power a conventional steam turbine. The HRSG recovers heat from a hot gas stream and produces [[steam]], the steam utilized to power the [[steam turbine]]s.

== About GIPCL ==
Gujarat Industrial Power Corporation Limited (GIPCL) is a Public Limited company incorporated in 1985. The company has been promoted by Gujarat's [[State-owned enterprise|Public Sector Undertakings]] (PSUs), namely [[Gujarat State Fertilizers and Chemicals|GSFC]], [[Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited|GACL]], Petrofils Co-operative Ltd., and [[Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam|GUVNL]]. In 1992, GIPCL commissioned its first power plant at Vadodara. It is a gas bases combined cycle power plant with 145 MW capacity. The concept of this power plant is a group [[captive power plant]], which supplies power to promoter companies; the power distribution to the promoters is in proportion to their original equity holding.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Market|first=Capital|date=2020-12-09|title=GIPCL jumps on securing land in Gujarat|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/gipcl-jumps-on-securing-land-in-gujarat-120120900215_1.html|access-date=2021-03-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210302063945/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/gipcl-jumps-on-securing-land-in-gujarat-120120900215_1.html|archive-date=2021-03-02}}</ref>
